answer: Cosignatures are collected in quill, verified in quartz, and inlet names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 19 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 30 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
